title: Comparative outcomes of posterior sub-Tenon triamcinolone for pseudophakic cystoid macular edema in diabetic and non-diabetic patients: a retrospective study

groups.agent: posterior sub-Tenon triamcinolone acetonide 1 mg/0.1 mL (preservative-free)
groups.description: Group 1: pseudophakic cystoid macular edema after uncomplicated phacoemulsification in non-diabetic patients, refractory to at least 4-6 weeks of topical corticosteroid and/or NSAID, treated with one posterior sub-Tenon triamcinolone injection; 24 eyes of 24 patients (retrospective, 2018-2021).

groups.agent: posterior sub-Tenon triamcinolone acetonide 1 mg/0.1 mL (preservative-free)
groups.description: Group 2: as Group 1 in diabetic patients without diabetic retinopathy; 19 eyes of 19 patients.

decision: excluded: no admissible series (both tabulated groups are complete-case sets: minimum follow-up of six months equal to the last tabulated visit)

exclusions.what: Table 3 (Tab3) BCVA (LogMAR) of Group 1 and Group 2 before and 1, 3 and 6 months after PST
exclusions.reason: complete-case set: the study included only patients with a minimum follow-up of six months (Abstract Methods), which is the last tabulated visit; the article does not state that no treated eye was left out (protocol inclusion 5; brief complete-case ruling)

exclusions.what: Table 3 IOP rows and intra- and intergroup p-values
exclusions.reason: not acuity; p-values are not admissible

exclusions.what: BCVA values in the Abstract and Figure 3
exclusions.reason: text and figure values of the same excluded sets

notes: BCVA was measured with a Snellen chart (Methods); Table 3 states BCVA in logMAR as mean +/- SD with no Snellen or decimal row, so the unit and statistic would be admissible, but both groups are complete-case sets.
Groups are defined at baseline by diabetes status (control subgroups); the two groups are the whole cohort.
Central macular thickness (Table 2) and IOP (Table 3) are reported in the article and mentioned here only.
No record is written: the study has no admissible series under extraction protocol 1.0.0 and the extraction brief.
